provenance.asset_description: Three life-sized foam kobolds sitting on a table in a back yard. A red kobold on the left, with the hard cover Crown of the Kobold King at its feet. A blue kobold in the middle with a special edition copy of Crown of the Kobold King at its feet. And another red kobold on the right. In front of the kobolds are an Order of the Amber Die hoodie and an Order of the Amber Die t-shirt
